label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Si negando niega su padre a darla a él, plata pesará conforme a dote de las vírgenes.
spanish: Si negando niega su padre a darla a él, plata pesará conforme al precio de las vírgenes.
grammarChanges: Replaced "dote" with "precio" per the cited mismatch: H4119 מֹהַר is the price paid for the bride, not a dowry contributed by her.
Added the article "al" before "precio" for correct Spanish agreement ("conforme al precio de las vírgenes").
